items.title: Ada Rovatti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 13, 2022
items.q: Ada was interviewed via Zoom on December 13, 2022 by Monk Rowe

ctx.x: Ada was interviewed via Zoom on December 13, 2022 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I’m at Hamilton College for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m really pleased to have Ada Rovatti with me this afternoon. Welcome.
Well thank you. Thank you for having me.
